title: Environment variables and dotenv
description: Load synthetic settings with Node's built-in dotenv support, validate configuration at startup, and separate public settings from private values.
objectives: Explain process environment variables and local dotenv files
Load configuration from a file without committing real credentials
Validate numeric and enum settings before using them
Prevent private settings from entering client-facing data and logs
rubric: I loaded a synthetic environment file and inspected only safe fields.
I validated configuration values, including invalid ports and missing tokens.
I passed tests proving private tokens are excluded from public output.
